label: R19-QUARTUS-PHYSICAL
title: Run fresh A10 synthesis, fitter and signoff STA for the R19 timing batch
scope: Prepare an exact-source fresh remote probe for R19, prove manifest and canonical QSF closure, then serialize synthesis, fitter, signoff STA and custom directional reports after resource admission. Compare R19 against both T-014/R17 and T-020/R18 if the latter becomes available.
reads: T-020 preparation and guard scripts as templates

validation.preflight: exact source SHA, local/remote manifest, QSF external closure, no EDA conflict, >=16 GiB free memory and low interactive CPU load
validation.stages: synthesis -> fitter -> sta_signoff -> custom_sta; one remote stage at a time with safety stop below 14 GiB free

acceptance: All allowed physical stages and report parsing complete on an exact R19 manifest; report Fmax, setup WNS/TNS/failing endpoints, hold/recovery/removal/min-pulse, resource delta and replacement top-N without claiming closure when any required check is negative.
resource: Do not overlap T-020 or another Quartus job. Admission requires EDA_COUNT=0, free memory >=16 GiB, no forbidden artifacts and a low-load window; runtime safety-stops the Quartus tree below 14 GiB free. Never terminate unrelated processes.
blocked_reason: Fresh synthesis, fitter and signoff STA passed, but report_directional.tcl treated the expected disappearance of the old TX_DONE endpoint as fatal exit 29, so top-50 and remaining directional queries were not reached.
board_policy: No assembler, bitstream, programming, JTAG, power-on or board test without explicit user permission.
